svg.title: Figure 3 — HBM3E wafer-supply intensity versus DDR5
svg.desc: A relative-index bar chart showing DDR5 at one and HBM3E at approximately three under same-node and same-bits conditions from Micron's disclosure.
svg.text: HBM3E uses materially more wafer supply per bit
Relative wafer-supply index under Micron's same technology node / same number of bits boundary
Source: Micron Technology, FY24 Q2 Prepared Remarks (2024-03-20).
Boundary: physical wafer-supply trade ratio at the same node and same bits; not a price multiple and not a permanent ratio for every HBM generation.
